title: Critique: if micro-subjects fuse, the result is emergence

statements.text: If micro-subjects go out of existence to make a macro-subject, their points of view are annihilated, not bequeathed, so the macro-subject is not a structural product of its parts and panpsychism has become a form of emergentism.

sources.quote: If points of view are annihilated so as to produce a macro-subject, the macro-subjectivity is not a structural property.
